name: museum
note: Fixture lexicon for the conformance corpus. Invented and deliberately dull: it exists so that every construct of the language can be exercised once, not to model any real domain. Its file layout is provisional until the dictionary schema is fixed; the meaning of each verb is stated in prose under 'means' so that an implementer can reproduce the evaluate/ cases.

have.means: the subject has the object: either a field of the subject declared as a reference to the object's type is set (to any entity matching the object's filter), or an entity of the object's type exists whose reference field of the subject's type points at the subject

have completed.subject: curator
have completed.means: a completion exists whose curator is the subject and whose course matches the object; with a time expression, its 'completed on' falls in the window

be located in.subject: exhibit
be located in.means: the subject's gallery matches the object

be lent to.subject: exhibit
be lent to.means: a loan exists whose exhibit is the subject, whose lender matches the object, and whose 'returned on' is empty

be returned.subject: loan
be returned.means: the subject's 'returned on' is set; with an anchored time expression, it falls in the window relative to the anchor

be inspected.subject: gallery
be inspected.means: an inspection exists whose gallery is the subject; with a time expression, its 'inspected on' falls in the window

publish.subject: curator
publish.means: a report exists whose author is the subject and which matches the object; with a period, one such report per period

review.subject: curator
review.means: declared for the cadence shape; its evaluation is not exercised by the corpus

approve.subject: curator
approve.means: a loan matching the object exists whose approver is the subject

be assigned to.subject: curator
be assigned to.means: declared for the aggregate count shape; its evaluation is not exercised by the corpus

Humidity.means: the mean of 'humidity' over the readings whose gallery is the subject and whose 'measured on' falls in the window

Availability.means: the share of readings whose device is the subject and whose 'measured on' falls in the window that have 'available' true, as a percentage

appraisal-v2.claim: the exhibit's recorded value is consistent with its most recent appraisal
appraisal-v2.confidence: the judge's estimate that a second appraisal would agree, from 0 to 1
